body:
MIGRATION_5_6 (T-153: items.expense_*, lists.currency_*, membersJson,
closeVotesJson, closedAt) has never run. Not once, anywhere:

- all 34 Android test databases use inMemoryDatabaseBuilder, which creates the
  schema at the CURRENT version, so no migration executes;
- there is no MigrationTestHelper test, and androidTest holds no Kotlin at all.

Why it matters more than a missing unit test. AppDb registers the migration and
does NOT call fallbackToDestructiveMigration, so if Room finds the migrated
schema does not match the entities it throws on first database access — which on
this app is launch. An upgrading user gets a crash loop until they clear data.

Mitigating, but not a substitute: MIGRATION_5_6 has the same shape as
MIGRATION_4_5, which shipped in 1.10.0 and has run on a real device through four
releases. Column names and types were checked against the entities by hand.

Wanted:
1. exportSchema = true plus a schema location in build.gradle.kts, and the
   generated schema JSONs committed (they are the input MigrationTestHelper
   needs and are worth having in review anyway).
2. A MigrationTestHelper test that creates a version-5 database, writes a row,
   runs MIGRATION_5_6, and asserts the new columns exist with the old row
   intact. That also covers 1->5, which have never been executed either.

Related: server migration 7 (T-157, close_votes + lists.closed_at) also has no
test that executes it, unlike migration 6. Cheaper: extend test_closing.py the
way test_expenses.py covers migration 6.

Do this before the phase-1 release (T-156), since that is the build existing
users upgrade into.
title: Room migration 5->6 has never been executed by any test
